title: Rise in Individual Bankruptcy Applications to 18-year High
what_it_is: Rise in Individual Bankruptcy Applications to 18-year High

sections.label: Bankruptcy and winding up applications
sections.summary: Bankruptcy applications and compulsory winding up applications rose in 2023, but actual orders and winding ups were lower and below pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Although bankruptcy applications in Singapore rose in 2023, not all applications resulted in bankruptcy orders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The actual bankruptcy orders were lower than the application numbers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The trend of bankruptcy orders has been largely stable over the recent years, and it is also below pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Likewise, while compulsory winding up applications did indeed pick up in 2023, the actual winding up numbers were lower and, also, below pre-COVID-19 levels, quite comparable.

sections.label: Household and corporate loan resilience
sections.summary: Most corporates and households serviced their loans, with no significant rise in non-performing loans and adequate buffers shown in MAS stress tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, most corporates and households were able to weather the increases in borrowing costs and continued to service their loans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: There have not been any significant uptick in banks' non-performing loans for either households or corporates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Stress tests by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) also show that most corporates and household borrowers have adequate buffers to manage shocks to income and financing costs.

sections.label: Debt repayment scheme for debtors
sections.summary: The official assignee administers a debt repayment scheme for eligible debtors with debts not exceeding $150,000, who repay over five years to avoid bankruptcy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: When a bankruptcy application is filed, the official assignee administers a debt repayment scheme to help eligible debtors whose debts do not exceed $150,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: These debtors can avoid bankruptcy by committing to the terms of a repayment plan with a creditor and repaying their debts over a period of five years.
